3776.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3776.text: You can use our online Medicare application if you :

3777.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3777.text: Are at least 64 years and 9 months old ;

3778.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3778.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3778.text: Want to sign up for Medicare but do not currently have ANY Medicare coverage ;

3779.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3779.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3779.text: Do not want to start receiving Social Security benefits at this time ;

3780.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3780.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3780.text: Are not currently receiving Social Security retirement, disability or survivors benefits.

3781.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3781.heading: When should I apply?
3781.text: You should sign up for Medicare three months before reaching age 65, even if you are not ready to start receiving retirement benefits.

3782.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3782.heading: When should I apply?
3782.text: You can opt out of receiving cash retirement benefits now once you are in the online application.

3783.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3783.heading: When should I apply?
3783.text: Then you can apply online for retirement benefits later.

3784.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3784.heading: When should I apply?
3784.text: you can sign up for Medicare Part A Hospital Insurance and Part B Medical Insurance.

3785.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3785.heading: When should I apply?
3785.text: Because you must pay a premium for Part B coverage ,

3786.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3786.heading: When should I apply?
3786.text: If you choose not to enroll in Medicare Part B and then decide to do so later ,

3787.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3787.heading: When should I apply?
3787.text: your coverage may be delayed and you may have to pay a higher monthly premium for as long as you have Part B.

3788.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3788.heading: When should I apply?
3788.text: Your monthly premium will go up 10 percent for each 12-month period you were eligible for Part B, but didn t sign up for it, unless you qualify for a " Special Enrollment Period.

3789.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3789.text: If you have medical insurance coverage under a group health plan based on your or your spouse's current employment ,

3790.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3790.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3790.text: you may not need to apply for Medicare Part B at age 65.

3791.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3791.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3791.text: You may qualify for a " Special Enrollment Period " SEP that will let you sign up for Part B during :

3792.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3792.text: Any month you remain covered under the group health plan and your, or your spouse's, employment continues ;

3793.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#1
3793.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3793.text: The 8-month period that begins with the month after your group health plan coverage or the employment it is based on ends ,

3835.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3835.heading: Learn about Medicare
3835.text: Medicare is our country s health insurance program for people age 65 or older.

3836.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3836.heading: Learn about Medicare
3836.text: Certain people younger than age 65 can qualify for Medicare, too, including those with disabilities and those who have permanent kidney failure.

3839.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2

3839.text: you can get information and services online.

3840.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3840.heading: Already Enrolled in Medicare
3840.text: Find out how to manage your benefits.

3841.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3841.heading: Already Enrolled in Medicare
3841.text: If you already have Medicare Part A and wish to sign up for Medicare Part B, please complete form CMS 40-B, Application for Enrollment in Medicare - Part B Medical Insurance, and take or mail it to your local Social Security office.

3842.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3842.heading: Already Enrolled in Medicare
3842.text: Anyone who has Medicare can get Medicare prescription drug coverage.

3843.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3843.heading: Already Enrolled in Medicare
3843.text: Some people with limited resources and income also may be able to get Extra Help to pay for the costs.

3844.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3844.heading: Applying for Medicare
3844.text: you can sign up for Part A Hospital Insurance and Part B Medical Insurance.

3845.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3845.heading: Applying for Medicare
3845.text: Because you must pay a premium for Part B coverage ,

3846.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3846.heading: Applying for Medicare
3846.text: if you decide to enroll in Part B later on ,

3847.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3847.heading: Applying for Medicare
3847.text: you may have to pay a late enrollment penalty for as long as you have Part B coverage.

3848.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3848.heading: Applying for Medicare
3848.text: Your monthly premium will go up 10 percent for each 12-month period you were eligible for Part B, but didn t sign up for it, unless you qualify for a special enrollment period.

3849.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3849.heading: Applying for Medicare
3849.text: If you re eligible at age 65 ,

3850.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3850.heading: Applying for Medicare
3850.text: your initial enrollment period begins three months before your 65th birthday, includes the month you turn age 65, and ends three months after that birthday.

3851.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3851.heading: Applying for Medicare
3851.text: if you don t enroll in Medicare Part B during your initial enrollment period ,

3852.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3852.heading: Applying for Medicare
3852.text: you have another chance each year to sign up during a general enrollment period from January 1 through March 31.

3853.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3853.heading: Applying for Medicare
3853.text: Your coverage begins on July 1 of the year you enroll.

3854.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3854.heading: Applying for Medicare
3854.text: Read our Medicare publication for more information.

3855.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3855.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3855.text: You can use our online Medicare application if you :

3856.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3856.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3856.text: Are at least 64 years and 9 months old ;

3857.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3857.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3857.text: Want to sign up for Medicare but do not currently have ANY Medicare coverage ;

3858.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3858.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3858.text: Do not want to start receiving Social Security benefits at this time ;

3859.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3859.heading: Who can apply for Medicare online?
3859.text: Are not currently receiving Social Security retirement, disability or survivors benefits.

3860.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3860.heading: When should I apply?
3860.text: You should sign up for Medicare three months before reaching age 65, even if you are not ready to start receiving retirement benefits.

3861.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3861.heading: When should I apply?
3861.text: You can opt out of receiving cash retirement benefits now once you are in the online application.

3862.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3862.heading: When should I apply?
3862.text: Then you can apply online for retirement benefits later.

3863.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2

3863.text: you can sign up for Medicare Part A Hospital Insurance and Part B Medical Insurance.

3864.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3864.heading: When should I apply?
3864.text: Because you must pay a premium for Part B coverage ,

3865.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3865.heading: When should I apply?
3865.text: If you choose not to enroll in Medicare Part B and then decide to do so later ,

3866.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3866.heading: When should I apply?
3866.text: your coverage may be delayed and you may have to pay a higher monthly premium for as long as you have Part B.

3867.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3867.heading: When should I apply?
3867.text: Your monthly premium will go up 10 percent for each 12-month period you were eligible for Part B, but didn t sign up for it, unless you qualify for a " Special Enrollment Period.

3868.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3868.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3868.text: If you have medical insurance coverage under a group health plan based on your or your spouse's current employment ,

3869.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3869.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3869.text: you may not need to apply for Medicare Part B at age 65.

3870.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3870.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3870.text: You may qualify for a " Special Enrollment Period " SEP that will let you sign up for Part B during :

3871.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3871.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3871.text: Any month you remain covered under the group health plan and your, or your spouse's, employment continues ;

3872.title: Medicare Benefits | Social Security Administration#2
3872.heading: Special Enrollment Period (SEP)
3872.text: The 8-month period that begins with the month after your group health plan coverage or the employment it is based on ends ,

3933.heading: Benefits for People with Disabilities
3933.text: The Social Security and Supplemental Security Income disabilityprograms are the largest of several Federal programs that provideassistance to people with disabilities.

3934.title: Benefits for People with Disabilities#1

3934.text: While these two programsare different in many ways ,

4139.text: Effectively managing your retirement benefits is an ongoing part of retired life.

4140.text: A solid foundation for this includes understanding what you re entitled to, staying up to date on program changes, and making sure we have your current information.

4141.text: Help ensure you get the retirement benefits you should by reviewing the basics like how we determine your benefit amount and who else in your family might be eligible.

4142.text: Visit our Learn About Retirement Benefits page to make sure you know the basics of retirement benefits.

4180.heading: Keep Your Information Secure
4180.text: Identity theft affects millions of people each year and can cause serious financial and identity - related problems.

4181.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4181.heading: Keep Your Information Secure
4181.text: Protect yourself by securing your personal information, taking the time to understand the threat of identity theft, and exercising caution.

4182.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4182.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4182.text: Social Security is diligently working at national, regional, and local levels to combat the fraud that undermines our mission to serve the American public.

4183.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4183.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4183.text: There are steps you can take to help protect your personal information :

4184.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4184.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4184.text: Do not routinely carry your Social Security card.

4185.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4185.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4185.text: Never say your Social Security number aloud in public.

4186.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4186.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4186.text: Beware of phishing scams emails, internet links, texts, and phone calls to trick you into revealing personal information.

4187.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4187.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4187.text: Create a my Social Security account to help you keep track of your records.

4188.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4188.heading: Protect Yourself From Fraud
4188.text: Visit If You Want Extra Security to learn about extra verification steps we can add to your account.

4189.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4189.heading: Report Suspicious Activity
4189.text: If you receive a suspicious call from someone claiming to be from Social Security ,

4190.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4190.heading: Report Suspicious Activity
4190.text: hang up and then report details of the call to the Office of the Inspector General.

4191.title: Manage Your Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4191.heading: Report Suspicious Activity
4191.text: You can do this by submitting a report online.

4203.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4203.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4203.text: Social Security replaces a percentage of a worker s pre - retirement income based on their lifetime earnings.

4204.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4204.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4204.text: The portion of your pre - retirement wages that Social Security replaces is based on your highest 35 years of earnings and varies depending on how much you earn and when you choose to start benefits.

4205.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4205.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4205.text: The Social Security system works like this :

4206.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4206.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4206.text: when you work, you pay taxes into Social Security.

4207.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4207.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4207.text: We use the tax money to pay benefits to :

4209.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4209.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4209.text: Survivors of workers who have died.

4210.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4210.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4210.text: The money you pay in taxes isn t held in a personal account for you to use when you get benefits.

4211.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4211.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4211.text: We use your taxes to pay people who are getting benefits right now.

4212.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4212.heading: How Retirement Benefits Work
4212.text: Any unused money goes to a Social Security trust fund that pays monthly benefits to you and your family when you start receiving retirement benefits.

4253.text: The age you begin collecting your retirement benefit affects how much you will receive.

4254.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4254.heading: What Age Should You Start To Receive Benefits?
4254.text: There are three important things to know about age when thinking about when to start your benefits.

4255.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4255.heading: Full Retirement Age
4255.text: Full retirement age is the age when you will be able to collect your full retirement benefit amount.

4256.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4256.heading: Full Retirement Age
4256.text: The full retirement age is 66 if you were born from 1943 to 1954.

4257.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4257.heading: Full Retirement Age
4257.text: The full retirement age increases gradually if you were born from 1955 to 1960, until it reaches 67.

4259.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4259.heading: Full Retirement Age
4259.text: full retirement benefits are payable at age 67.

4260.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1

4261.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1
4261.heading: Early Retirement Age
4261.text: You can get Social Security retirement benefits as early as age 62.

4262.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1

4262.text: your benefit is reduced if you start receiving benefits before your full retirement age.

4263.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1

4266.title: Learn About Retirement Benefits | SSA#1

9141.heading: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)
9141.text: TSGLI also known as Servicemembers Group Life Insurance Traumatic Injury Protection provides short - term financial support to help eligible service members recover from a severe injury.

9142.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9142.heading: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)
9142.text: If you were covered by SGLI and experienced a traumatic injury while serving in the military ,

9143.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9143.heading: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)
9143.text: find out how to file a claim for TSGLI or appeal a past decision.

9144.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9144.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9144.text: You may be able to get TSGLI if you were insured by SGLI when you experienced a traumatic injury ,

9145.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9145.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9145.text: and you meet all of the requirements listed below.

9146.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9146.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9146.text: Have a scheduled loss that is a direct result of the traumatic injury ,

9147.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9147.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9147.text: Suffered the traumatic injury before midnight on the day that you left the military ,

9148.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9148.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9148.text: Suffered a scheduled loss within 2 years 730 days of the traumatic injury ,

9149.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9149.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9149.text: Have survived for a period of not less than 7 full days from the date of the traumatic injury the 7-day period begins on the date and time of the traumatic injury and ends 168 full hours later ,

9150.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9150.heading: Am I eligible for TSGLI?
9150.text: Were an active - duty military member, a Reservist, a National Guard member, on funeral - honors duty, or on 1-day muster duty

9151.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9151.heading: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
9151.text: none of the descriptions below can be true of your injury.

9152.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9152.heading: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
9152.text: Be self - inflicted on purpose or the result of an attempt at self - injury, or

9153.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9153.heading: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
9153.text: Involve the use of an illegal drug or a controlled substance that was given or taken without the advice of a medical doctor ,

9154.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9154.heading: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
9154.text: Be the result of medical or surgical treatment of an illness or disease, or

9155.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1
9155.heading: Are any injuries excluded from TSGLI?
9155.text: Occur while you re committing or trying to commit a felony, or

9156.title: Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI) | Veterans Affairs#1

11119.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11119.heading: How do I apply for a VA Survivors Pension?
11119.text: You can apply in any of these ways :

11120.heading: By mail
11120.text: Fill out an Application for DIC, Death Pension, and/or Accrued Benefits VA Form 21 - 534EZ.

11122.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11122.heading: By mail
11122.text: Mail it to the pension management center PMC for your state.

11123.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11123.heading: In person
11123.text: Bring your application to a VA regional office near you.

11124.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11124.heading: In person
11124.text: Find a VA regional benefit office near you

11125.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11125.heading: With the help of a trained professional
11125.text: You can work with a trained professional called an accredited representative to get help applying for VA survivors pension benefits.

11126.title: VA Survivors Pension | Veterans Affairs#1
11126.heading: How long does it take VA to make a decision?
11126.text: We process VA Survivors Pension claims in the order we receive them, unless a claim requires priority processing.

11363.text: Veterans who served on a Blue Water Navy vessel offshore of the Republic of Vietnam, or on another U.S. Navy or Coast Guard ship operating in the coastal waterways of Vietnam between January 9 , 1962, and May 7 , 1975, are now entitled to a presumption of service connection for illnesses related to Agent Orange exposure.

11771.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11771.text: If you re a Veteran with a disability we ve concluded is the result of an illness or injury caused or made worse by your active - duty service called a service - connected disability ,

11772.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11772.text: you may be able to get special compensation to help with disabilities like the ones listed below.

11773.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11773.heading: Special claims
11773.text: Automobile allowance and adaptive equipmentIf your service - connected disability prevents you from driving, find out if you can get money to help buy a specially equipped vehicle or make needed changes to your existing vehicle.

11774.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11774.heading: Special claims
11774.text: Birth defects linked to Agent OrangeIf you were exposed to specific chemicals while serving in Vietnam, Thailand, or the Korean Demilitarized Zone ,

11775.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11775.heading: Special claims
11775.text: and your child has spina bifida or other birth defects ,

11776.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11776.heading: Special claims
11776.text: your child may be eligible for disability benefits.

11777.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11777.heading: Special claims
11777.text: Replacing damaged clothingIf your clothing s been damaged by your prosthetic or orthopedic device or by medicine you re taking for a skin condition find out if you can get money to help buy new clothes.

11778.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11778.heading: Special claims
11778.text: Recovery from surgery or an immobilizing disability convalescence If you re recovering from surgery or other treatment that s left you unable to move ,

11779.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1
11779.heading: Special claims
11779.text: find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits.

11780.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11781.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11782.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11783.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

11784.title: Special Claims | Veterans Affairs#1

12046.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12046.text: Driving School Licenses are issued to businesses that qualify to operate a driving school.

12047.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12047.text: These licenses are renewed for two years.

12048.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12048.text: The license must be renewed before the expiration date shown on the license if the driving school wants to continue to operate the business.

12049.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12049.text: Driving School Licenses can be renewed up to six 6 months after they expire ,

12050.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12050.text: but the Driving School business cannot operate unless the license is valid.

12051.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12051.heading: How to renew
12051.text: Your application for renewal of a Driving School License must be submitted between 30 and 60 days before the license expires the expiration date is printed on your license.

12052.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12052.heading: How to renew
12052.text: As part of the renewal process ,

12053.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12053.heading: How to renew
12053.text: you must provide updated information about your driving school including :

12054.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12054.heading: How to renew
12054.text: Driving School Renewal Application [1] form MV-522

12055.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12055.heading: How to renew
12055.text: Proof of Worker s Compensation form C-105.2 or U-26.3 and Disability Benefits Insurance Coverage form DB-120.1, OR a Certificate of Attestation of Exemption of Worker s Compensation and Disability Benefits Insurance Coverage form CE-200.

12056.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12056.heading: How to renew
12056.text: You must include a check or money order for the renewal fee as identified on the application, payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.

12058.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12058.heading: How to renew
12058.text: If your school uses vehicles for instruction ,

12059.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12059.heading: How to renew
12059.text: you must attach a List of Driving School Vehicles [2] MV-527.

12060.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12060.heading: How to renew
12060.text: If your school provides the Pre - licensing Course ,

12061.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12061.heading: How to renew
12061.text: you must attach a Signature Authorization List - Pre - Licensing Course [3] MV-278.6.

12062.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12062.heading: Expired Driving School License
12062.text: You must immediately stop operating your driving school business.

12063.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12063.heading: Expired Driving School License
12063.text: Your school will not be licensed to operate.

12064.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12064.heading: Expired Driving School License
12064.text: Any services you provide through your driving school license including Instructor Certificates, account to DMV s online road test appointment scheduling system, and authorization to order Pre - Licensing Course Completion Certificates will be terminated.

12065.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12065.heading: Expired Driving School License
12065.text: Until your new license is issued ,

12066.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12066.heading: Expired Driving School License
12066.text: your instructors will not be able to teach for your school and your school will be unable to :

12067.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12067.heading: Expired Driving School License
12067.text: teach the Pre - licensing Course if your school was approved to teach this

12068.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12068.heading: Expired Driving School License
12068.text: schedule road tests or bring customers to a road test

12069.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12069.heading: Expired Driving School License
12069.text: You can renew the license up to 6 months after the previous license expires BUT any operation of your business between when your driving school license expired and the new license is issued will constitute unlicensed operation of a driving school.

12070.title: Renew Driving School License#3
12070.heading: Expired Driving School License
12070.text: This could result in your having to pay a civil penalty of $1,000 and/or denial of future driving school license applications.

12733.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12733.heading: INTRODUCTION
12733.text: If you are issued a ticket for a non - criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New York City ,

12734.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12734.heading: INTRODUCTION
12734.text: it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles DMV Traffic Violations Bureau TVB.

12735.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12735.heading: INTRODUCTION
12735.text: This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked aggravated unlicensed operation.

12736.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12736.heading: INTRODUCTION
12736.text: TVBs do not handle parking violations.

12737.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12737.heading: INTRODUCTION
12737.text: If you plead not guilty to a traffic ticket in one of these TVB areas ,

12738.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12738.heading: INTRODUCTION
12738.text: your case will be heard by a DMV Administrative Law Judge ALJ, an experienced attorney with special training in the Vehicle and Traffic Law.

12739.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12739.heading: INTRODUCTION
12739.text: An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if you are found guilty.

12740.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12740.heading: INTRODUCTION
12740.text: An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

12741.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12741.heading: INTRODUCTION
12741.text: Just as in traffic courts in other areas of the state ,

12742.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12742.heading: INTRODUCTION
12742.text: you may present witnesses and evidence at a hearing before an ALJ and be represented by an attorney.

12743.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12743.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12743.text: Follow the instructions on the ticket for the plea you wish to make, and act promptly.

12744.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12744.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12744.text: If you don't answer the ticket in the time allowed ,

12745.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12745.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12745.text: your driver license will be suspended.

12746.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12746.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12746.text: you could be found guilty of the charge because of your failure to respond a default conviction.

12747.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12747.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12747.text: Your license would be suspended for not paying the fine and a judgment would be entered against you.

12748.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12748.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12748.text: Driving with a suspended license is a crime.

12749.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12749.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12749.text: A felony conviction may result in fines of up to $5,000, jail, probation, or confiscation of your vehicle.

12750.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12750.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12750.text: As the number of suspensions you have increases ,

12751.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12751.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12751.text: A driver is suspended for ticket not answered and fine not paid.

12752.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12752.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12752.text: To Plead Not Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the " not guilty " instructions and check the " not guilty " box on the back of the ticket.

12753.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12753.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET

12754.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12754.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12754.text: and mail the ticket to the Albany address listed.

12755.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12755.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12755.text: DMV will send you a letter telling you when and where to go for your hearing.

12756.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12756.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12756.text: If you are hearing impaired and require an interpreter ,

12757.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12757.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12757.text: include a request for one when you mail your not guilty plea.

12758.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12758.heading: IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET
12758.text: An interpreter will be assigned to your hearing at no charge to you.

12759.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12759.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12759.text: Hearings are open to the public.

12760.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12760.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12760.text: You may go to any TVB office to watch hearings so you know what to expect at yours.

12761.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12761.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12761.text: To Plead Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the instructions and check the " guilty " box on the back of the ticket.

12763.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12763.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12763.text: either mail it with your payment to the Albany address listed on the ticket or bring your payment to any TVB office.

12764.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12764.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12764.text: You may pay the fine and surcharge by Visa or Mastercard, or by a check or money order payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.

12765.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12765.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12765.text: Include the total fines and surcharges listed on the ticket for your violation.

12766.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12766.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12766.text: You may not plead guilty by mail if the charge against you will result in license or registration suspension or revocation upon conviction such as driving without insurance or a third speeding violation within 18 months.

12767.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12767.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12767.text: If you plead guilty to such a charge by mail ,

12768.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12768.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12768.text: you will be notified that you must go to the TVB to answer the charge in person.

12769.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12769.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12769.text: If your mailing address is different from the address written on the front of the ticket ,

12770.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12770.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12770.text: please write the correct mailing address in the space provided on the back of the ticket.

12771.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12771.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12771.text: You may request your traffic ticket hearing to be postponed and rescheduled to a different date.

12773.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12773.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12773.text: the appropriate TVB must receive your request by mail at least 10 days before the date of the scheduled hearing.

12774.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12774.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12774.text: You may also make your postponement request in person at that office or by telephone at least one day before your hearing date.

12775.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12775.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12775.text: If it would be a second or subsequent postponement for the same ticket ,

12776.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12776.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12776.text: your request must be made in person at the appropriate TVB office at least one day before your hearing date.

12777.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12777.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12777.text: Your request for a second or subsequent postponement also must include a " good cause, " which is the reason you want the hearing rescheduled.

12778.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12778.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12778.text: Your " good cause " is subject to approval by a TVB Administrative Law Judge.

12779.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12779.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12779.text: For a traffic ticket issued within New York City: Mail your request to the Albany, NY, address on your ticket -

12780.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12780.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12780.text: the office must receive your request at least ten days before the date of your scheduled hearing.

12781.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12781.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12781.text: You also may make your request in person at any TVB office in New York City, or telephone the TVB at 718 -488 - 5710, at least one day before the date of your scheduled hearing.

12782.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12782.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12782.text: For a traffic ticket to be answered to a TVB outside New York City :

12783.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12783.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12783.text: Mail your request to the TVB office indicated on your ticket.

12784.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12784.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12784.text: The office must receive your request at least ten days before the scheduled hearing date.

12785.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12785.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12785.text: You also may make your request in person to that TVB office or by telephone at least one day before the date of your scheduled hearing

12786.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12786.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12786.text: You are considered innocent of the charge against you unless you are proven guilty at your hearing.

12787.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12787.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12787.text: You cannot be found guilty unless there is " clear and convincing evidence " that you committed the violation.

12788.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12788.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12788.text: If you find it hard to understand English ,

12789.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12789.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12789.text: you may bring someone to help you.

12790.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12790.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12790.text: Tell the ALJ, before the hearing starts, that someone who speaks your native language and English is there to interpret.

12791.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12791.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12791.text: The ALJ will listen to sworn testimony from the police officer, who will explain why you were given the ticket.

12792.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12792.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12792.text: you or your attorney may ask the officer questions.

12793.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12793.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12793.text: You also may bring witnesses to testify for you and written evidence.

12794.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12794.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12794.text: The judge may ask witnesses questions to better understand their testimony.

12795.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12795.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12795.text: You do not have to testify but you may if you wish.

12796.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12796.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12796.text: You cannot be found guilty just because you do not testify.

12797.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12797.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12797.text: When all of the evidence and testimony have been given ,

12798.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12798.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12798.text: the ALJ will decide whether or not you are guilty.

12799.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12799.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12799.text: That decision will be based only on the evidence and testimony presented at the hearing and what the law states.

12800.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12800.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12800.text: If the ALJ decides the charge against you was not proven by clear and convincing evidence ,

12801.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12801.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12801.text: If the charge is proven and you are found guilty ,

12802.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12802.heading: ATTEND YOUR HEARING
12802.text: Your license or registration also may be suspended or revoked, depending on the violation and your overall driving record.

12803.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12803.heading: APPEALS
12803.text: If you believe the ALJ's decision was incorrect based on the facts and the law ,

12804.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12804.heading: APPEALS
12804.text: You can determine if you can file an appeal online [2] or download Traffic Violations Bureau Appeal form [3] AA-33 from the DMV web site.

12805.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12805.heading: APPEALS
12805.text: The appeal form is also available at TVB offices.

12807.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12807.heading: APPEALS
12807.text: your attorney may help you file the appeal.

12808.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12808.heading: APPEALS
12808.text: Remember to include a payment for the appeal fees.

12809.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12809.heading: APPEALS
12809.text: and the appeal form and fees must be sent to :

12810.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12810.heading: APPEALS
12810.text: The State Department of Motor Vehicles Traffic Violations Bureaus handle parking tickets or violations by pedestrians.

12811.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12811.heading: APPEALS
12811.text: These are usually handled by a local parking violations bureau or court.

12812.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12812.heading: APPEALS
12812.text: The most common reasons your license may be suspended or revoked due to motor vehicle violations follow.

12813.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12813.heading: APPEALS
12813.text: your license also will be suspended if you do not answer a ticket or pay a fine.

12814.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12814.heading: APPEALS
12814.text: An ALJ has the authority to suspend or revoke your license for violations other than those listed.

12815.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12815.heading: APPEALS
12815.text: Speeding / Misdemeanors If you commit three speeding and/or misdemeanor traffic violations within 18 months ,

12816.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12816.heading: APPEALS
12816.text: your license will be revoked for at least six months.

12817.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12817.heading: APPEALS
12817.text: New Driver Probation You are on license probation for six months after you pass a road test.

12818.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12818.heading: APPEALS
12818.text: If you are found guilty of committing any two moving violations during your probation period ,

12819.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12819.heading: APPEALS
12819.text: your license will be suspended for 60 days.

12820.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12820.heading: APPEALS
12820.text: It will also be suspended for 60 days if you are found guilty of committing a single, more serious violation during the probation period, including speeding, tailgating, unauthorized racing or reckless driving.

12821.title: Traffic Violations Bureau#3
12821.heading: APPEALS
12821.text: For violations committed on or after November 1 , 2014 - If you are found guilty of committing a texting / cell phone violation during the probation period ,

12990.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12990.text: The Point and Insurance Reduction Program PIRP is a DMV - approved course designed to teach motorists critical information about Highway Safety and Accident Prevention.

12991.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12991.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12991.text: The course sponsor will mail you a completion certificate within 45 business days after you complete the classroom course or 14 business days after you complete an online course.

12992.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12992.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12992.text: If you present your certificate to your insurance company or agent within 90 days after course completion ,

12993.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12993.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12993.text: your liability and collision premium reduction will begin immediately, retroactive to the date you completed the course.

12994.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12994.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12994.text: If you present your certificate more than 90 days after course completion ,

12995.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12995.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12995.text: the insurer may issue the premium discount effective from the date presented.

12996.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12996.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12996.text: If you do not receive your certificate within eight weeks after completion ,

12997.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12997.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?

12998.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12998.heading: How do I get the insurance premium reduction?
12998.text: You must take the course once every 36 months to maintain insurance reduction benefits.

12999.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
12999.heading: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?
12999.text: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?

13000.title: How insurance premium reduction works#3
13000.heading: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?
13000.text: PIRP does not prevent general premium increases, or premium increases due to violations or accidents.

13365.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp65
13365.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13365.heading: CHANGE OF ADDRESS
13365.text: cross out the old address on your registration document and write in the new one.

13366.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13366.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp66
13366.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13366.heading: CHANGE OF ADDRESS
13366.text: You also must report your address change to the DMV [6] within 10 days.

13367.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13367.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp67
13367.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13367.heading: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
13367.text: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE

13368.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13368.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp68
13368.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13368.heading: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
13368.text: If your ATV has become stolen ,

13369.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13369.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp69
13369.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13369.heading: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
13369.text: you should immediately report the theft to the police.

13370.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13370.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp70
13370.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13370.heading: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
13370.text: If the ATV is to be, or already has been, destroyed or permanently removed from New York State ,

13371.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13371.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp71
13371.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13371.heading: THEFT, DESTRUCTION, REMOVAL FROM THE STATE
13371.text: you should surrender the plate and registration document to a local motor vehicle office.

13372.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13372.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp73
13372.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13372.heading: OUT-OF-STATE REGISTRATIONS
13372.text: New York State honors valid out - of - state ATV registrations.

13373.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13373.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp74
13373.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13373.heading: OUT-OF-STATE REGISTRATIONS
13373.text: If your home state does not require ATV registration ,

13374.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13374.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp75
13374.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13374.heading: OUT-OF-STATE REGISTRATIONS
13374.text: you must obtain a New York State registration before operating your ATV in this state.

13375.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13375.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp77
13375.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13375.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13375.text: You do not need a driver license to operate an ATV in New York State ,

13376.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13376.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp78
13376.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13376.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13376.text: but certain restrictions apply to operators under age 16.

13377.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13377.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp79
13377.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13377.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13377.text: If you are age 10 through age 15 ,

13378.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13378.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp83
13378.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13378.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13378.text: Without adult supervision on lands owned or leased by your parent or guardian ;

13379.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13379.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp85
13379.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13379.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13379.text: On any lands where ATV use is permitted ,

13380.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13380.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp87
13380.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13380.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13380.text: if you have completed an ATV safety training course approved by the DMV.

13381.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13381.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp88
13381.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13381.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13381.text: You should carry your course completion certificate when operating any ATV.

13382.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13382.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp93
13382.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13382.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13382.text: Without adult supervision on lands owned or leased by your parent or guardian.

13383.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13383.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp94
13383.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13383.heading: WHO MAY OPERATE AN ATV
13383.text: Adult Supervision means being accompanied by a person at least 18 years of age, or a person 16 or 17 years of age who holds an ATV safety course completion certificate from an approved safety course provider.

13384.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13384.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp95
13384.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13384.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION

13385.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13385.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp96
13385.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13385.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13385.text: ATV safety training courses approved by the Department of Motor Vehicles are available throughout the state.

13386.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13386.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp97
13386.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13386.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION

13387.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13387.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp105
13387.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13387.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13387.text: ATV safety information also is available on the internet at www.nyatvsafety.net [7].

13388.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13388.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp106
13388.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13388.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13388.text: Written questions about New York State's ATV or motorcycle safety programs should be addressed through the DMV web site or by mail :

13389.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13389.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp107
13389.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13389.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13389.text: NYS DMV Motorcycle Safety Program6 Empire State Plaza ,

13390.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13390.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp108
13390.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13390.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION

13391.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13391.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp109
13391.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13391.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13391.text: The application forms identified in this publication for ATV owners and operators are available at any motor vehicle office or at the DMV web site: dmv.ny.gov [8 ]

13392.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13392.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp110
13392.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13392.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION

13393.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13393.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp111
13393.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13393.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13393.text: A parent or guardian may not knowingly permit or authorize his or her child under age 16 to operate an ATV in violation of state or local laws.

13394.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13394.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp112
13394.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13394.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13394.text: An ATV owner, or another person in possession of an ATV, may not knowingly permit or authorize any person under age 16 to operate an ATV in violation of any state or local law.

13395.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13395.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp113
13395.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13395.heading: SAFETY TRAINING AND INFORMATION
13395.text: Both the owner and the operator of an ATV may be held liable for injury and/or damages resulting from an ATV accident.

13396.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13396.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp114
13396.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13396.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13396.text: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS

13397.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13397.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp115
13397.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13397.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13397.text: DMV recommends you avoid crossing a highway unless absolutely necessary.

13398.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13398.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp118
13398.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13398.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13398.text: You must cross at an angle of approximately 90 degrees, at a place where there are no obstructions to prevent a quick, safe crossing.

13399.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13399.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp119
13399.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13399.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13399.text: You must come to a complete stop and yield the right - of - way to traffic on the highway before crossing.

13400.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13400.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp120
13400.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13400.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13400.text: You may cross a divided highway only where it intersects with another street or highway.

13401.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13401.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp121
13401.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13401.heading: WHERE AND WHEN TO DRIVE ACROSS HIGHWAYS
13401.text: You may not cross an interstate highway or any controlled - access highway, such as the Thruway or a parkway at any time.

13402.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13402.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp123
13402.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13402.heading: ON HIGHWAYS
13402.text: You may not operate an ATV on a highway unless it has been designated and posted for ATV use by the state or local authority.

13403.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13403.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp125
13403.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13403.heading: ON HIGHWAYS
13403.text: only the part of a highway between two off - highway trails will be posted for ATV use.

13404.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13404.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp126
13404.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13404.heading: ON HIGHWAYS
13404.text: Check with local police to be sure.

13405.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13405.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp127
13405.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13405.heading: ON HIGHWAYS
13405.text: DMV recommends that you turn your headlight and taillight on and wear bright, reflective clothing whenever you ride on a highway.

13406.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13406.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp128
13406.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13406.heading: ON HIGHWAYS
13406.text: Always enter the highway with care, and yield to other traffic.

13407.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13407.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp130
13407.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13407.heading: ON PUBLIC LAND
13407.text: You may not operate an ATV on public land unless it is specifically designated for ATV use ,

13408.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13408.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp131
13408.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13408.heading: ON PUBLIC LAND
13408.text: and it is allowed by a posted sign.

13409.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13409.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp133
13409.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13409.heading: ON PRIVATE LAND
13409.text: To operate an ATV on private land ,

13410.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13410.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp134
13410.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13410.heading: ON PRIVATE LAND
13410.text: you must have permission of the land owner or lessee.

13411.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13411.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp136
13411.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13411.heading: ON PRIVATE LAND
13411.text: make sure you know the boundaries of the property, and respect any special restrictions or requests of the land owner.

13412.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13412.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp137
13412.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13412.heading: ON PRIVATE LAND
13412.text: You could lose permission to ride on private land by littering, causing damage, or riding carelessly.

13413.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13413.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp139
13413.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13413.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13413.text: Whether you are the operator or passenger ,

13414.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13414.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp140
13414.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13414.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13414.text: you must wear a USDOT - approved helmet when riding an ATV.

13415.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13415.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp141
13415.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13415.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13415.text: DMV recommends that you also wear a face shield or goggles, and protective clothes and footwear.

13416.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13416.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp142
13416.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13416.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13416.text: Your ATV must have the following equipment :

13417.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13417.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp144
13417.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13417.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13417.text: which is in good operating condition and meets federal standards

13418.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13418.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp146
13418.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13418.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13418.text: A spark arrester approved by the U.S. Forest Service

13419.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13419.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp147
13419.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13419.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13419.text: Tires with at least 2/32nds of an inch tread without visible breaks, cuts, exposed cords, bumps or bulges

13420.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13420.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp149
13420.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13420.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13420.text: A lighted white headlight and red taillight

13421.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13421.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp150
13421.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13421.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13421.text: The law requires you to keep the ATV's headlight and taillight lighted when riding a half hour after sunset to a half hour before sunrise.

13422.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13422.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp152
13422.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13422.heading: REQUIRED EQUIPMENT
13422.text: DMV recommends you keep the lights on at all times.

13423.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13423.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp154
13423.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13423.heading: RIDING RESTRICTIONS
13423.text: In addition to obeying the ATV laws and rules ,

13424.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13424.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp155
13424.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13424.heading: RIDING RESTRICTIONS
13424.text: it is wise to ride your ATV with common sense and courtesy.

13425.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13425.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp156
13425.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13425.heading: RIDING RESTRICTIONS
13425.text: Having fun on an ATV does not include annoying others or taking foolish risks.

13426.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13426.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp157
13426.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13426.heading: RIDING RESTRICTIONS
13426.text: ATV riders who ignore the rules and the rights of others may cause ATV operation to be restricted or prohibited on private and public lands.

13427.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13427.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp159
13427.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13427.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13427.text: Other than while seated on the permanent, regular seat.

13428.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13428.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp161
13428.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13428.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13428.text: unless the ATV is designed to carry a passenger.

13429.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13429.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp162
13429.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13429.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13429.text: At a speed too fast for existing conditions or potential hazards.

13430.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13430.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp163
13430.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13430.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13430.text: In a careless, reckless or negligent manner.

13431.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13431.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp164
13431.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13431.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13431.text: While intoxicated or impaired by alcohol or drugs.

13432.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13432.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp165
13432.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13432.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13432.text: On the tracks or right - of - way of a railroad.

13433.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13433.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp167
13433.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13433.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13433.text: if the ATV is equipped with studded tires other than automobile - type studs.

13434.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13434.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp168
13434.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13434.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13434.text: In a tree nursery or planting in a manner which damages or destroys growing stock or creates a substantial risk of damage or destruction.

13435.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13435.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp169
13435.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13435.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13435.text: Within 100 feet of a dwelling between midnight and 6 A.M. at a speed greater than necessary to keep the ATV moving.

13436.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13436.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp170
13436.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13436.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13436.text: While pulling a person on skis, a toboggan, sleigh, sled or trailer, unless the device is attached to the ATV by a tow - bar or other rigid connection.

13437.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13437.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp171
13437.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13437.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13437.text: On the ice or public water within 100 feet of a person ,

13438.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13438.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp172
13438.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13438.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13438.text: fishing shanty or shelter at a speed greater than necessary to keep the ATV moving.

13439.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13439.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp173
13439.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13439.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13439.text: Over an area cleared of snow for skating ,

13440.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13440.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp174
13440.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13440.heading: YOU MAY NEVER OPERATE AN ATV
13440.text: unless necessary for access to public waters.

13441.doc_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0
13441.section_id: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3_0__sp176
13441.title: ATVs: Information for Owners and Operators#3
13441.heading: LOCAL LAWS

15098.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15098.heading: The Course
15098.text: How much time does the PIRP course take, what is it like and what does it cost?

15099.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15099.heading: The Course
15099.text: you will have two options for completing the PIRP course.

15100.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15100.heading: The Course
15100.text: Your options will be the traditional classroom method or an Alternate Delivery Method ADM, such as the Internet or other DMV approved method.

15102.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15102.heading: The Course
15102.text: each course is at least six hours long.

15103.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15103.heading: The Course
15103.text: Note: The motorcycle safety / accident prevention courses take substantially longer and are only available in a classroom setting.

15104.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15104.heading: The Course
15104.text: Essential information about traffic safety issues such as driver attitude and behavior, defensive driving techniques, and the Vehicle & Traffic Law must be presented in each course.

15105.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15105.heading: The Course
15105.text: For both the classroom and ADM methods ,

15106.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15106.heading: The Course
15106.text: additional content, approach, materials and fees vary from one sponsor to the next.

15107.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15107.heading: The Course
15107.text: Information specific to the classroom course :

15108.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15108.heading: The Course
15108.text: The course is presented in one or more classroom sessions and attendance is mandatory.

15109.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15109.heading: The Course
15109.text: No formal testing is required to complete the course.

15110.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15110.heading: The Course
15110.text: For information on where to attend a course ,

15111.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15111.heading: The Course

15112.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15112.heading: The Course
15112.text: You may also contact one of the program sponsors presented in the DMV publication, " List of Course Sponsors " C-31, available at any state or county motor vehicle office and by request from DMV Call Center.

15113.heading: The Course
