15126.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15126.heading: Point Reduction
15126.text: After I complete the PIRP course ,

15127.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15127.heading: Point Reduction
15127.text: how do I receive the point reduction?

15128.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15128.heading: Point Reduction
15128.text: The PIRP sponsor will notify the DMV within ten weeks after you complete the course.

15129.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15129.heading: Point Reduction
15129.text: A notice will then be entered on your driving record ,

15130.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15130.heading: Point Reduction
15130.text: and the DMV computer will automatically reduce your active point total by up to four points.

15131.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15131.heading: Point Reduction
15131.text: Completion of a course under the " Point & Insurance Reduction Program " does not remove, delete, subtract, or erase any violation, conviction, or notice of original number of points from your driving record.

15132.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15132.heading: Point Reduction
15132.text: Even after you complete the course ,

15133.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15133.heading: Point Reduction
15133.text: most violations, conviction and points assessed will continue to show on your driving record for up to four years.

15134.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15134.heading: Point Reduction
15134.text: Violations and convictions involving drugs or alcohol will remain on your driving record for ten or fifteen years, depending on the violation.

15135.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15135.heading: Point Reduction
15135.text: " Point reduction " means the DMV will not count up to four points on your driving record toward license revocation or suspension.

15136.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15136.heading: Point Reduction
15136.text: How do I know my driving record shows my PIRP course completion?

15137.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15137.heading: Point Reduction
15137.text: If you need to verify the course completion has been entered on your record ,

15138.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15138.heading: Point Reduction
15138.text: you may request a copy of your driving record from the DMV.

15139.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15139.heading: Point Reduction
15139.text: you can order your driving record online [3], or complete a Request for Driver and/or Vehicle Record Information [4] MV-15.

15140.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15140.heading: Point Reduction
15140.text: This form is available on the DMV website at dmv.ny.gov [1] or at any motor vehicle office.

15141.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15141.heading: Point Reduction
15141.text: If your course completion is not noted on your driving record more than ten weeks after you completed it ,

15142.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15142.heading: Point Reduction
15142.text: What effect does point reduction have on my license and driving record?

15143.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15143.heading: Point Reduction
15143.text: Point reduction applies only to points assessed for violations that occurred within the eighteen months immediately before course completion.

15144.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15144.heading: Point Reduction
15144.text: It does not affect points for earlier violations, and cannot be used as " credit " against future violations or points.

15145.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15145.heading: Point Reduction
15145.text: Point reduction cannot reduce your point total lower than zero.

15146.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15146.heading: Point Reduction
15146.text: If your license has already been revoked or suspended, or if a violation hearing has already been scheduled ,

15147.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15147.heading: Point Reduction
15147.text: point reduction will not affect that action.

15148.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15148.heading: Point Reduction
15148.text: Point reduction does not prevent or cancel a mandatory revocation or suspension for violations such as DWI, DWAI, or three speeding violations within 18 months.

15149.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15149.heading: Point Reduction
15149.text: Points may be reduced only once in any 18-month period.

15150.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15150.heading: Point Reduction
15150.text: The DMV point system and insurance company " point " systems are separate and not related.

15151.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15151.heading: Point Reduction
15151.text: Point reduction on your driving record does not affect points assigned by your insurance company for violations and accidents.

15152.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15152.heading: Point Reduction
15152.text: Completion of a course under the " Point & Insurance Reduction Program " also cannot prevent or reduce the calculation of points affecting a " Driver Responsibility Assessment.

15153.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15153.heading: Point Reduction
15153.text: The most recent information about the Driver Responsibility Assessment [5] program is available from the DMV web site.

15155.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15155.heading: Insurance Reduction
15155.text: how do I receive the insurance reduction?

15156.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15156.heading: Insurance Reduction
15156.text: The course sponsor should mail you a completion certificate within 45 days after you complete the course.

15157.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15157.heading: Insurance Reduction
15157.text: If you present your certificate to your insurance company or agent within 90 days after course completion ,

15158.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15158.heading: Insurance Reduction
15158.text: your liability and collision premium reduction will begin immediately, retroactive to the date you completed the course.

15159.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15159.heading: Insurance Reduction
15159.text: If you present your certificate more than 90 days after course completion ,

15160.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15160.heading: Insurance Reduction
15160.text: the insurer may issue the premium discount effective from the date presented.

15161.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15161.heading: Insurance Reduction
15161.text: If you do not receive your certificate within eight weeks after completion ,

15163.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15163.heading: Insurance Reduction
15163.text: You may take the course once every 36 months to maintain insurance reduction benefits.

15164.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15164.heading: Insurance Reduction
15164.text: Will the PIRP course prevent my insurance company from raising my premiums?

15165.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15165.heading: Insurance Reduction
15165.text: Insurance reduction does not prevent general premium increases, or premium increases due to violations or accidents.

15166.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15166.heading: Insurance Reduction
15166.text: It provides a 10% reduction for three years, from the base rate of your current liability, no - fault and collision premiums.

15167.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15167.heading: Insurance Reduction
15167.text: What if more than one person named on a policy completes the PIRP course?

15168.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15168.heading: Insurance Reduction
15168.text: The insurance premium reduction applies to all motor vehicles principally operated by the motorist who completes the course.

15169.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15169.heading: Insurance Reduction
15169.text: The reduction can be applied to only one driver for each covered vehicle.

15170.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15170.heading: Insurance Reduction
15170.text: Will youthful operators and drivers participating in assigned risk pool receive the insurance premium discount?

15171.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15171.heading: Insurance Reduction
15171.text: Any insured driver who is the principal operator and completes a Point & Insurance Reduction Program course will receive the reduction.

15172.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15172.heading: Insurance Reduction
15172.text: If a youthful operator is already receiving a driver education reduction ,

15173.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15173.heading: Insurance Reduction
15173.text: will the PIRP discount also be applied?

15174.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15174.heading: Insurance Reduction
15174.text: Check with your insurance company or agent to find out if both reductions will be given at the same time.

15175.text: The following table shows the point values assigned to moving traffic violations.

15176.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15176.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15176.text: The " points " are assessed against your driving record based on the date you committed the violation, not the date you were convicted in court.

15177.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15177.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15177.text: If you accumulate 11 or more points in 18 months ,

15178.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15178.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15178.text: you will be called to a DMV hearing, after which your license may be suspended or revoked.

15179.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15179.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15179.text: You will be offered the option of waiving the hearing or accepting a definite period of suspension.

15180.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15180.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15180.text: Some license revocations and suspensions are mandatory and do not depend on points.

15181.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15181.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15181.text: These include three speeding violations within 18 months, and convictions involving alcohol or drugs.

15182.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15182.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15182.text: For more information about license suspensions and revocations ,

15183.title: Point & Insurance Reduction Program#3
15183.heading: DMV Point System Summary
15183.text: please refer to the publication Suppose Your License Were Taken Away [6] C-12, available at any motor vehicle office.

15747.heading: Pay driver civil penalty[1]
15747.text: A driver civil penalty is a fine you must pay to DMV for certain offenses before your license or driving privilege can be restored after a suspension or revocation.

15749.heading: Pay driver civil penalty[1]

16055.text: You will abide by these Terms of Service; and the Terms of Service and Acceptable Use Policy for the use of NY.gov ;

16056.text: You certify that all identifying personal information provided to create or access your account is accurate, and pertains solely to you as the User of the account ;

16057.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16057.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16057.text: Any false statement, false certification, or false information provided in creating or using a account constitutes a criminal act which may result in the imposition of criminal sanctions ;

16058.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16058.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16058.text: For the purpose of imposing criminal sanctions ,

16059.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1

16059.text: any false statement you make in connection with creating the account ,

16060.text: and each fraudulent log - in to access applications or services ,

16061.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1

16061.text: may be treated as a separate criminal offense.

16062.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16062.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16062.text: DMV reserves the right, and sole discretion, to revoke your Username and access to your account, at any time, without prior notification, in the interest of preserving the security of the system.

16063.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16063.text: You are responsible for all use of your account ,

16064.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16064.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16064.text: and you must protect your temporary password, Sign - In Username and Password from disclosure to any individual or entity, and must not permit the use of your account by another.

16065.text: You agree to Not bypass or attempt to bypass any security controls for access to your account ;

16066.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16066.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16066.text: You will keep your Username and Password in a secure place and manner ;

16067.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16067.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16067.text: You will prevent disclosure of your Username and Password ;

16068.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16068.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16068.text: You will prevent others from watching you enter your Username and Password ;

16069.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16069.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16069.text: You will select a Username and Password that is non - obvious and difficult to guess e.g., not use your name, or the names of your spouse, children, pets, or other things that publicly identify you ;

16070.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16070.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16070.text: You will sign off of the system whenever the your computer is unattended ;

16071.title: MyDMV Account Terms of Service#1
16071.heading: MyDMV Account Terms of Service[1]
16071.text: You will take any action required by DMV or NY.gov to re - certify your identity, or to change your Username or Password ;

16211.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16211.heading: Cars (Part 106.2 (e))
16211.text: You can register a car in the' Commercial' class if all the seats behind the driver are removed.

16212.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16212.heading: Cars (Part 106.2 (e))
16212.text: you must install a permanent box or permanent rack to carry cargo.

16214.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16214.heading: Station Wagons and Vans (Part 106.2 (f))
16214.text: You can register a station wagon in the' Commercial' class if all the seats and all the seat fittings behind the driver are removed completely.

16215.heading: Modifications that change a registration from 'Commercial' class to 'Passenger' class
16215.text: Modifications that change a registration from 'Commercial' class to 'Passenger' class

16217.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16217.text: You can register a pick - up in the' Passenger' class if it meets certain conditions, depending on its unladen weight.

16218.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16218.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16218.text: If your modified or unmodified pick - up truck has an unladen weight less than 6,001 lbs ., you can register it in the' Passenger' class if it meets the following conditions :

16219.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16219.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16219.text: the pick - up truck does not have any business advertisements

16220.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16220.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16220.text: the pick - up truck is used exclusively for non - commercial purposes

16221.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16221.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16221.text: If your modified pick - up truck with an unladen weight greater than 6,000 lbs ., you can register it in the' Passenger' class if it meets the following conditions :

16222.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16222.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16222.text: the pick - up truck does not have any business advertisements and is used exclusively for non - commercial purposes

16223.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16223.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16223.text: a camper top having one or more side windows completely encloses the truck bed

16224.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16224.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16224.text: the pick - up truck has seats, seat fittings, or camping equipment installed in the truck bed

16225.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16225.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16225.text: ' camping equipment indicates that you have a permanent bed, a permanent stove, or a permanent refrigerator in the vehicle.

16226.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16226.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16226.text: if this equipment is removed and you use the van ,

16227.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16227.heading: Pick-up Trucks (Part 106.6 (b) and (c))
16227.text: you must register the van as a commercial vehicle

16228.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16228.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16228.text: You can register it in the' Passenger' class if the van has

16229.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16229.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16229.text: at least one side window behind the driver ,

16230.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16230.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16230.text: at least one seat or set of seat fittings that is installed behind the driver ,

16231.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16231.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16231.text: camping equipment that is installed behind the driver.

16232.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16232.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16232.text: ' camping equipment' indicates that you have a permanent bed, a permanent stove, or a permanent refrigerator in the vehicle

16233.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16233.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16233.text: if you install seats behind the driver ,

16234.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16234.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16234.text: you must also install seatbelts that meet NY State Occupant Restraint Law requirements

16236.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16236.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16236.text: If you use a van or pick - up truck without the required modifications ,

16237.title: Vehicle modifications and registration class#3
16237.heading: Vans (Part 106.3 (d))
16237.text: then you must register it in the' Commercial' registration class.

16251.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16251.text: This is the 9 digit " ID " number printed in the upper portion of your driver license, learner permit or non driver ID DMV photo document.

16252.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16252.heading: Driver License Information
16252.text: Enter the 9 digits only; do not enter spaces, hyphens or other punctuation.

16254.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16254.heading: Driver License Information
16254.text: Enter your last name, first name and middle initial exactly as they would appear on your DMV photo document or another DMV document such as a driver record abstract, a revocation or suspension order or a letter related to your driver license.

16255.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16255.heading: Driver License Information
16255.text: If you are not sure how your name appears ,

16256.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16256.heading: Driver License Information
16256.text: follow these rules to enter your name.

16257.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16257.heading: Driver License Information
16257.text: names on DMV records appear in UPPERCASE and are displayed in UPPERCASE in online transactions

16258.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16258.heading: Driver License Information
16258.text: a suffix should be entered in Roman numerals for example " SMITH III, JOHN, A. "

16259.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16259.heading: Driver License Information
16259.text: do not enter spaces or special characters such as commas or apostrophes you can enter a hyphen if your name on DMV records includes a hyphen - for example, enter the name O'Brien as OBRIEN

16260.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16260.heading: Driver License Information

16261.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16265.heading: Driver License Information

16268.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16269.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16283.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16283.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16283.text: New York State law requires you to report a change of residence to the DMV within 10 days.

16284.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16284.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16284.text: When you submit a mailing address change online, and you do not have a residence address on file with the DMV ,

16285.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16285.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16285.text: you are required to enter a residence address.

16286.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16286.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16286.text: Your residence address cannot be a post office box.

16287.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16287.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16287.text: If you already have a residence address on file with the DMV ,

16288.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16288.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16288.text: you are not required to change it when you change your mailing address ,

16289.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16289.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16289.text: but you can change the residence address if you want to.

16290.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16290.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16290.text: Your residence address does not have to be the same as your mailing address ,

16291.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16291.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16291.text: but you can select to use your mailing address as your residence address.

16292.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16292.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16292.text: If you report a change of address to the US Postal Service USPS, it does not change your address on DMV records ,

16293.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16293.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16293.text: but you can enter the new USPS address National Change of Address or NCOA address in this transaction.

16294.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16294.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16294.text: When you change an address with the DMV ,

16295.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16295.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16295.text: does not change your address on DMV records other than your driver license / DMV photo document records and/or registration records that you select in the transaction for example, a change of address with the DMV does not change the address that appears on traffic ticket records

16296.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16296.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16296.text: does not change an address on a registration record if you selected " No change " for that registration in the transaction

16297.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16297.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16297.text: does not change your address with the USPS or on any other record outside the DMV records specified above

16298.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16298.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16298.text: does not generate new documents with your new address after you submit an online address change, you can replace your driver license, permit or non - driver ID [7] and/or replace your registration documents [8] that show your new address

16299.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16299.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16299.text: When you submit an address change online ,

16300.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16300.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16300.text: the change applies only to the DMV records you select.

16301.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16301.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16301.text: The online address change application shows the driver license, permit or non - driver ID DMV photo document and registration records that the DMV was able to locate under your name.

16302.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16302.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16302.text: If there are registrations in your name that are not shown ,

16303.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16303.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16303.text: you can enter the plate or registration number to add them to the list and change the address for those registrations.

16304.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16304.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16304.text: If you select " No Change " for any photo documents or registrations on your change address list ,

16305.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16305.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16305.text: the new address you enter for other DMV records will not apply to those records.

16306.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16306.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16306.text: If you want to change the address for those records to a different new address ,

16307.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16307.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16307.text: then you must process a separate address change and select only the records to which that address will be applied.

16308.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16308.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16308.text: If a driver license, non - driver ID or registration on your change of address list is eligible to be renewed ,

16309.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16309.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16309.text: the expiration date appears in bold red text on the Confirmation Page after you process the address change.

16310.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16310.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16310.text: You can then go online to renew your photo driver license or non - driver photo ID card [9], renew vehicle registration [10] or renew boat registrations [10] and receive documents with your new address displayed.

16311.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16311.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16311.text: After your address change is processed ,

16312.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16312.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16312.text: links are provided to order replacement duplicate documents that show your new address.

16313.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16313.heading: Entry of Addresses for DMV Records
16313.text: There are fees to order the replacement documents.

16314.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16314.heading: Online Manual Orders
16314.text: Most DMV manuals are available online through the DMV Publications [11] page.

16315.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16315.text: This includes the Online Driver's Manual and Study Guide with quizzes [12].

16316.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16316.heading: Online Manual Orders
16316.text: Single, printed copies of DMV manuals for drivers are also available free of charge at DMV offices [13] or by mail through the DMV Call Center [14] for your area code.

16317.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16317.text: For bulk manual orders for public or private organizations ,

16318.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16318.heading: Online Manual Orders
16318.text: use the online DMV Manual Order transaction [15].

16319.text: for public organizations see definition below there is no fee for bulk orders

16321.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16321.heading: Online Manual Orders
16321.text: A public organization and a private organization are defined as follows

16322.text: A public organization is defined as

16323.title: Information about transaction entries#3
16323.heading: Online Manual Orders
16323.text: that is division of the State, a county or a municipality

16326.title: Information about transaction entries#3

16329.text: is not created or formed by a provision of state or local law

16331.title: Driving in New York State#3
16331.heading: Who can drive here?
16331.text: To drive a car or motorcycle in New York State ,

16332.title: Driving in New York State#3
16332.heading: Who can drive here?
16332.text: be at least 16 years old 1 and

16333.title: Driving in New York State#3
16333.heading: Who can drive here?
16333.text: have a valid New York State driver license or learner permit ,

16334.title: Driving in New York State#3
16334.heading: Who can drive here?
16334.text: a valid driver license or permit issued by another state or country

16335.title: Driving in New York State#3
16335.heading: Who can drive here?
16335.text: If you have a New York State learner permit or one issued in another state ,

16336.title: Driving in New York State#3
16336.heading: Who can drive here?
16336.text: you must follow New York State permit restrictions [1].

16337.title: Driving in New York State#3
16337.heading: Who can drive here?
16337.text: you must obey New York's Graduated License Law [2].

16338.title: Driving in New York State#3
16338.heading: Residents of New York
16338.text: If you become a New York State resident ,

16339.title: Driving in New York State#3
16339.heading: Residents of New York
16339.text: you must get a New York State driver license within 30 days.

16340.title: Driving in New York State#3
16340.heading: Residents of New York
16340.text: If you have a valid driver license issued by another U.S. state or territory, federal district or Canadian province ,

16341.title: Driving in New York State#3
16341.heading: Residents of New York
16341.text: you may be eligible to exchange it for a New York driver license see Exchange an out - of - state license [3], or see other information about moving to New York [4].

16342.title: Driving in New York State#3
16342.heading: Residents of New York
16342.text: If your license was issued outside the U.S. or Canada ,

16343.title: Driving in New York State#3
16343.heading: Residents of New York
16343.text: you must apply for a new original New York State driver license at a DMV office see Get a driver license [5].

16344.title: Driving in New York State#3
16344.heading: Residents of New York
16344.text: When you pass your road test ,

16345.title: Driving in New York State#3
16345.heading: Residents of New York
16345.text: you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner.

16346.title: Driving in New York State#3
16346.heading: Residents of New York
16346.text: The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days.

16347.title: Driving in New York State#3
16347.heading: Residents of New York
16347.text: If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license ,

16348.title: Driving in New York State#3
16348.heading: Residents of New York
16348.text: ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

16349.title: Driving in New York State#3
16349.heading: Residents of New York
16349.text: Section 250 5 of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law says :

16350.title: Driving in New York State#3
16350.heading: Residents of New York
16350.text: To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in New York State for 90 days is considered " presumptive evidence " that you are a resident of New York State.

16351.title: Driving in New York State#3
16351.heading: Residents of New York
16351.text: A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.

16352.title: Driving in New York State#3
16352.heading: Residents of New York
16352.text: A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State.

16353.title: Driving in New York State#3
16353.heading: Residents of New York
16353.text: If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state ,

16354.title: Driving in New York State#3
16354.heading: Residents of New York
16354.text: a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make New York a " fixed and permanent " residence.

16355.title: Driving in New York State#3
16355.heading: Residents of New York
16355.text: students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of New York.

16356.title: Driving in New York State#3
16356.heading: Residents of New York
16356.text: DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a New York State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

16358.title: Driving in New York State#3
16358.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16358.text: You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another state or country.

16359.title: Driving in New York State#3
16359.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16359.text: You don t need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

16360.title: Driving in New York State#3
16360.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16360.text: If you have a driver license from another country you do not need to have an International Driving Permit ,

16361.title: Driving in New York State#3
16361.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16361.text: The permit verifies in several languages that you have a valid driver license.

16362.title: Driving in New York State#3
16362.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16362.text: Police officers who can t read the language on your foreign driver license will be able to read the permit.

16363.title: Driving in New York State#3
16363.heading: Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses
16363.text: Contact the authorities in your home country to get an International Driving Permit.

16364.title: Driving in New York State#3
16364.heading: Visitors from other countries
16364.text: If you have a driver license from any nation ,

16365.title: Driving in New York State#3
16365.heading: Visitors from other countries
16365.text: you do not need a New York State license to drive in New York State.

16366.title: Driving in New York State#3
16366.heading: Visitors from other countries
16366.text: You should only apply for a New York State driver license if you become a resident of New York State.

16367.title: Driving in New York State#3
16367.heading: Visitors from other countries
16367.text: If you do not have a license in your home country and want to get a New York State driver license ,

16368.title: Driving in New York State#3
16368.heading: Visitors from other countries
16368.text: you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre - licensing course and pass a road test.

16369.title: Driving in New York State#3
16369.heading: Students
16369.text: Students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered New York State residents.

16370.title: Driving in New York State#3
16370.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16370.text: You may drive in New York State with a learner permit issued in another state if

16371.title: Driving in New York State#3
16371.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16371.text: your out - of - state learner permit is valid outside the issuing state

16372.title: Driving in New York State#3
16372.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16372.text: you obey all restrictions of the state that issued the learner permit and

16373.title: Driving in New York State#3
16373.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16373.text: the general restrictions for learner permit holders [1] in New York State

16374.title: Driving in New York State#3
16374.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16374.text: the additional restrictions explained in the Graduated Driver License GDL Law and drivers under age 18 [2 ]

16375.title: Driving in New York State#3
16375.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16375.text: You cannot exchange out - of - state permit for a New York State permit.

16376.title: Driving in New York State#3
16376.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16376.text: You must apply for a New York permit at a DMV office if your out - of - state learner permit does not allow you to drive in New York State.

16377.title: Driving in New York State#3
16377.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16377.text: Even if you have a learner permit or a driver license from another state ,

16378.title: Driving in New York State#3
16378.heading: Out-of-state learner permits
16378.text: you are not exempt from this rule.

18717.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18717.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18717.text: every automotive dealer must register with the Department of Motor Vehicles DMV.

18718.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18718.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18718.text: A registered dealer must obey certain state and federal laws that protect your purchase of a new or used car, truck, or other motor vehicle, including one sold as " salvage.

18719.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18719.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18719.text: New vehicles are also protected by manufacturer's warranty.

18720.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18720.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18720.text: You can search for registered Automotive Dealers by using the Find a DMV - regulated Business [1] service.

18721.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18721.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18721.text: the dealer must certify, in writing, that it is " in condition and repair to render, under normal use, satisfactory and adequate service upon the public highway at the time of delivery.

18722.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18722.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18722.text: The dealer certification covers the entire vehicle except items that would be obvious to the customer before the sale, such as torn upholstery, missing hubcaps, etc.

18723.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18723.heading: Buying from a Dealer
18723.text: The vehicle also must have all safety equipment and emissions controls required by state and federal laws for the vehicle's model year.

18724.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18724.heading: A dealer also must:
18724.text: have the vehicle inspected before selling it to a retail customer, even if the vehicle is new.

18725.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18725.heading: A dealer also must:
18725.text: The inspection must be done within 30 days of the date of sale and before you take delivery.

18726.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18726.heading: A dealer also must:
18726.text: The dealer may charge you the inspection fee.

18727.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18727.heading: A dealer also must:
18727.text: provide service or repairs under the manufacturer's warranty if the dealer is franchised by that manufacturer.

18728.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18728.heading: A dealer also must:
18728.text: Warranty service also may be available from other dealers franchised by the manufacturer.

18729.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18729.heading: A dealer also must:
18729.text: indicate, in writing, on the bill of sale whether a vehicle sold to a retail buyer is new, used, reconstructed, rebuilt salvage, or originally not manufactured to U.S. standards see Title Branding.

18730.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18730.heading: A dealer also must:
18730.text: For motor vehicles that are 10 model years old or newer ,

18731.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18731.heading: A dealer also must:
18731.text: the seller must complete the odometer disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate.

18732.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18732.heading: A dealer also must:
18732.text: For vehicles older than 10 model years ,

18734.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18734.heading: A dealer also must:
18734.text: The damage disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate must be completed regardless of the vehicle s age.

18735.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18735.heading: A dealer also must:
18735.text: The DMV will not register or grant title to a salvaged vehicle without a completed salvage disclosure statement.

18736.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18736.heading: A dealer also must:
18736.text: the DMV must examine each vehicle branded or identified by the seller as " Rebuilt Salvage " for stolen parts before the vehicle can be registered or titled.

18737.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18737.heading: A dealer also must:
18737.text: complete and sign an odometer disclosure statement if the vehicle is 10 model years old or newer.

18738.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18738.heading: A dealer also must:
18738.text: This statement is on the Retail Certificate of Sale MV-50.

18739.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18739.heading: A dealer also must:
18739.text: The buyer also must acknowledge and sign the odometer statement.

18740.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18740.heading: A dealer also must:
18740.text: indicate on the sales contract when a passenger car had been used primarily as a police car, taxicab, driver education or rental car.

18741.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18741.heading: A dealer also must:
18741.text: If a lien is being recorded or the dealer issued number plates ,

18742.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18742.heading: A dealer also must:
18742.text: the dealer MUST handle the registration for you.

18743.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18743.heading: A dealer also must:
18743.text: The dealer may charge you up to $75 for this service, plus the actual fees for the vehicle's Certificate of Title MV-999, registration, and license plates.

18744.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18744.heading: A dealer also must:
18744.text: a registered dealer may submit your completed Vehicle Registration / Title Application MV-82 to the DMV.

18745.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18745.heading: A dealer also must:
18745.text: The dealer also may provide a temporary certificate of registration and, if needed, new license plates.

18746.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18746.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18746.text: One advantage of buying a vehicle from a private seller is the possibility of lower cost compared to buying from a dealer.

18747.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18747.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18747.text: A private seller does not have to follow important regulations that a dealer must obey.

18748.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18748.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18748.text: a private seller rarely offers a warranty.

18749.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18749.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18749.text: If you have a complaint about the vehicle or purchase ,

18750.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18750.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18750.text: you are on your own to resolve the problem with the seller, or in taking legal action.

18751.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18751.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18751.text: You cannot file a complaint with the DMV or other consumer assistance agencies if you buy a defective vehicle in a private sale.

18752.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18752.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18752.text: If you buy a vehicle 8 model years old or newer ,

18753.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18753.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18753.text: the DMV will NOT register or issue you a new title certificate unless the seller has completed, and you have signed, the damage disclosure statement on the reverse of the vehicle's Certificate of Title MV-999 or have attached a completed damage disclosure on an Odometer and Damage Disclosure Statement MV-103.

18754.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18754.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18754.text: This statement indicates whether or not the vehicle's new title certificate should be branded " Rebuilt Salvage " see Title Branding.

18755.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18755.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18755.text: An Odometer and Damage Disclosure Statement pdf [2] MV-103 is available at any motor vehicle office.

18756.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18756.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18756.text: For motor vehicles that are 10 model years old or newer ,

18757.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18757.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18757.text: the seller must complete the odometer disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate.

18758.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18758.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18758.text: For vehicles older than 10 model years ,

18760.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18760.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18760.text: The damage disclosure statement on the back of the title certificate must be completed regardless of the vehicle s age.

18761.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18761.heading: Buying From a Private Seller
18761.text: THE DMV MUST EXAMINE EVERY VEHICLE IDENTIFIED AS " REBUILT SALVAGE " FOR STOLEN PARTS BEFORE THE VEHICLE CAN BE REGISTERED OR TITLED.

18762.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18762.heading: Title Branding
18762.text: If a vehicle has been rebuilt, originally not manufactured to U.S. standards, or reconstructed ,

18763.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18763.heading: Title Branding
18763.text: a branding notice must be printed in capital letters on the front of the New York State title certificate.

18764.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18764.heading: Title Branding
18764.text: A dealer must inform a customer, in writing, if a branded vehicle is being shown or sold to a retail customer.

18765.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18765.heading: Title Branding
18765.text: This may be a notice placed on the dealer's bill of sale or handed to the customer.

18766.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18766.heading: Title Branding
18766.text: You can also find a printed notice on the front of the title certificate if a vehicle previously had been returned to the manufacturer, its agent, or dealer because it did not conform to warranty.

18767.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18767.heading: Title Branding
18767.text: It also will be printed on the title after a final determination of a court finding or settlement under the state's Lemon Law.

18768.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18768.heading: Title Branding
18768.text: THIS VEHICLE WAS RETURNED TO THE MANUFACTURER OR DEALER BECAUSE IT DID NOT CONFORM TO ITS WARRANTY.

18769.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18769.heading: Title Branding
18769.text: The brands below may be printed on a New York State Certificate of Title MV-999 for 1973 and newer vehicles :

18770.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18770.heading: REBUILT SALVAGE/NY
18770.text: A vehicle with this label has been rebuilt after being wrecked, destroyed or damaged in excess of 75 percent of its retail value at the time of loss, or originally had entered New York State under a branded out - of - state title.

18771.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18771.heading: REBUILT SALVAGE/NY
18771.text: Previous branding includes Salvage, Rebuilt Salvage, Salvage Restored, Junk, Parts Only, Water Damage, or other description.

18772.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18772.heading: REBUILT SALVAGE/NY
18772.text: The Rebuilt Salvage branding will remain on the title for as long as the vehicle exists, no matter how many improvements are made to the vehicle.

18773.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18773.heading: NON-USA-STD
18773.text: A vehicle with this label was not originally manufactured in compliance with United States emissions or safety standards, or both.

18774.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18774.heading: RECONSTRUCTED
18774.text: A vehicle with this label has been repaired or constructed with a glider kit, but not one manufactured in two or more stages.

18775.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18775.heading: RECONSTRUCTED
18775.text: A glider kit includes all components of a vehicle except the power train.

18776.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18776.heading: RECONSTRUCTED
18776.text: It is generally used to rebuild heavy trucks or tractors that have been extensively damaged.

18777.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18777.heading: RECONSTRUCTED
18777.text: Passenger cars built from custom kits are not considered reconstructed vehicles.

18778.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18778.heading: Reported Mileage
18778.text: Vehicles over 10 model years old are exempt from mileage disclosure.

18780.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18780.heading: Reported Mileage
18780.text: the odometer mileage reported during the vehicle's most recent transfer of ownership is printed on the front of its New York State Certificate of Title MV-999.

18781.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18781.heading: Reported Mileage
18781.text: If the odometer had passed its maximum reading at the time of sale ,

18782.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18782.heading: Reported Mileage
18782.text: the description " EXCEEDS MECHANICAL LIMITS " will be printed below the reported mileage.

18783.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18783.heading: Reported Mileage
18783.text: If the actual mileage is unknown because the odometer is broken, or has been repaired or replaced ,

18784.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18784.heading: Reported Mileage
18784.text: the front of the title will be printed with " NOT ACTUAL MILEAGE, WARNING ODOMETER DISCREPANCY.

18785.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18785.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18785.text: National Motor Vehicle Title Information System NMVTIS Vehicle History For Consumers [3] at YouTube

18786.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18786.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18786.text: Vehicle price is not controlled by any government agency.

18787.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18787.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18787.text: Take time to choose a vehicle that meets your needs and budget.

18788.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18788.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18788.text: compare prices by checking newspaper ads and visit a number of dealers and/or private sellers.

18789.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18789.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18789.text: Then take it for a test drive.

18790.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18790.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18790.text: examine the engine, transmission, drive axles, steering and suspension, brakes and electrical system.

18791.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18791.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18791.text: If you do not know what to look for ,

18792.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18792.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18792.text: it may be wise to pay a professional automotive technician to examine the vehicle.

18793.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18793.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18793.text: Before you buy from a dealer ,

18794.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18794.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18794.text: find out about dealer or manufacturer warranties, what they cover, and for how long.

18795.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18795.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18795.text: Ask if the dealer performs service or subcontracts to a repair shop.

18796.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18796.heading: Choosing a Vehicle
18796.text: Be sure all agreements, guarantees and warranties are in writing.

18797.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18797.heading: What to look for
18797.text: Examine the vehicle in bright daylight.

18798.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18798.heading: What to look for
18798.text: Look carefully at the body for signs of collision damage or rust.

18799.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18799.heading: What to look for
18799.text: Check the paint and vinyl top, sides, or trim for signs of wear or damage.

18800.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18800.heading: What to look for
18800.text: Check all lights, lenses and mirrors for cracks or other damage.

18801.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18801.heading: What to look for
18801.text: Look inside the vehicle for signs of wear or damage that may reduce its value, such as splits or holes in the upholstery.

18802.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18802.heading: What to look for
18802.text: Make sure all seat belts are in place, and in good working condition.

18803.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18803.heading: What to look for
18803.text: Look under the rugs or mats for dampness or water damage, which could mean there are body leaks.

18804.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18804.heading: What to look for
18804.text: Open the trunk or rear hatch and check for leaks.

18805.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18805.heading: What to look for
18805.text: Examine the spare tire, taking it out if necessary.

18806.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18806.heading: What to look for
18806.text: Make sure the jack and lug wrench are there.

18807.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18807.heading: What to look for
18807.text: Examine the engine compartment for signs of rusted metal around fenders, oil leaks, or excessive dirt on the engine.

18808.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18808.heading: What to look for
18808.text: These can be signs of high mileage.

18809.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18809.heading: What to look for
18809.text: Look at and feel rubber parts such as fan belts and radiator hoses.

18810.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18810.heading: What to look for
18810.text: If they are hard, cracked or too soft ,

18811.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18811.heading: What to look for
18811.text: Make sure the exhaust emissions control systems are intact and working.

18812.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18812.heading: What to look for
18812.text: Start the vehicle when the engine is cold and listen to make sure it runs smoothly when cold.

18813.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18813.heading: What to look for
18813.text: check the dash gauges and all inside and outside lights.

18814.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18814.heading: What to look for
18814.text: Make sure the heater, defrosters, air conditioner, windshield washer and wipers work properly.

18815.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18815.heading: What to look for
18815.text: If the vehicle is properly registered ,

18816.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18816.heading: What to look for
18816.text: you may choose to take it for a test drive.

18818.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18818.heading: What to look for
18818.text: and the transmission should shift without hesitation, roughness or loud noises.

18819.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18819.heading: What to look for
18819.text: Drive the vehicle on a straight, flat surface, and let go of the steering wheel for a moment to see if the front wheels follow a straight track without pulling to either side.

18820.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18820.heading: What to look for
18820.text: there should be no unusual noise, vibration, or pulling to either side.

18821.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18821.heading: What to look for
18821.text: Your test drive should include stop - and - go driving on local streets and driving at highway speeds, over a variety of surfaces and several hills.

18822.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18822.heading: What to look for
18822.text: Note how well the vehicle runs and handles.

18823.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18823.heading: What to look for
18823.text: check to see if the engine overheats.

18824.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18824.heading: What to look for
18824.text: If you are satisfied after the test drive ,

18825.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18825.heading: What to look for
18825.text: have the vehicle raised on a lift or jacks.

18826.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18826.heading: What to look for
18826.text: Examine the condition of the brakes, tires, front and rear suspension, exhaust system and catalytic converter.

18827.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18827.heading: What to look for
18827.text: Look for oil or fluid leaks underneath.

18828.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18828.heading: Taking Delivery
18828.text: If you decide the vehicle is in good condition and worth the price ,

18829.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18829.heading: Taking Delivery
18829.text: be sure the seller has the proper ownership and transfer documents.

18830.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18830.heading: Taking Delivery
18830.text: Ask the seller, and examine the title certificate, for information about unsatisfied liens bank loans, etc . .

18831.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18831.heading: Taking Delivery
18831.text: Carefully examine all documents before you pay for the vehicle.

18832.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18832.heading: Taking Delivery
18832.text: have the seller make out a bill of sale in addition to the ownership and sales tax documents.

18833.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18833.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18833.text: the proof of ownership is a Manufacturer's Certificate of Origin MCO and the dealer's " Certificate of Sale " MV-50.

18834.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18834.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18834.text: the proof of ownership is the Certificate of Title MV-999, or a transferable registration for 1972 and older models, signed over to the dealer, and the dealer's Certificate of Sale MV-50 showing ownership transfer to you.

18835.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18835.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18835.text: and you must acknowledge by signing, the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements.

18836.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18836.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18836.text: the proof of ownership is the Certificate of Title MV-999, or a transferable registration for 1972 or older models, signed over to you.

18837.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18837.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18837.text: and you must acknowledge by signing, the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements.

18838.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18838.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18838.text: Be sure the private seller completes the seller's section of the form Statement of Transaction - Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All - Terrain Vehicle ATV, Vessel Boat, or Snowmobile pdf [4] at NY State Department of Tax and Finance DTF-802, available at motor vehicle offices or at the DMV web site.

18839.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18839.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18839.text: This form certifies the purchase price and determines the sales tax you must pay when registering the vehicle.

18840.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18840.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18840.text: If the form is not filled out by the seller ,

18841.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18841.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18841.text: you will be charged sales tax based on the vehicle's current fair market value.

18842.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18842.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18842.text: Before you accept the title certificate from the seller ,

18843.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18843.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18843.text: check the front of the title for the names and addresses of lien holders.

18844.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18844.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18844.text: A lien indicates the current owner owes money on a loan for the vehicle.

18845.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18845.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18845.text: If a lien is listed on the title, ask the seller to give you the proof the lien has been paid

18846.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18846.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18846.text: - in most cases, it will be an official from the lender.

18847.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18847.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18847.text: the lien holder could repossess the vehicle from you.

18848.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18848.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18848.text: If you have a concern or question about the title, registration, sales tax or proof of ownership ,

18849.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18849.heading: Proofs of Vehicle Ownership
18849.text: contact the DMV Call Center or any motor vehicle office before you buy the vehicle.

18850.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18850.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18850.text: Before you trade in or sell your old vehicle ,

18851.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18851.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18851.text: be sure to remove the license plates and the windshield registration sticker, which shows your plate number.

18852.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18852.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18852.text: This will help prevent you from being charged with parking tickets that do not belong to you.

18853.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18853.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18853.text: Turn in the plates to a motor vehicle office unless you are transferring them to a replacement vehicle.

18854.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18854.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18854.text: Always turn in your plates before you cancel liability insurance or before the insurance lapses.

18855.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18855.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18855.text: If you do not, your registration will be suspended ,

18856.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18856.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18856.text: and your driver license could be suspended as well.

18857.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18857.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18857.text: When transferring the vehicle's title certificate to a new owner ,

18858.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18858.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18858.text: you must fill out the appropriate odometer and damage disclosure statements, and sign your name at " Seller's Signature.

18859.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18859.heading: Trading In or Selling Your Vehicle
18859.text: Then enter the seller's information on the sales tax form Statement of Transaction - Sale or Gift of Motor Vehicle, Trailer, All - Terrain Vehicle ATV, Vessel Boat, or Snowmobile pdf [4] at NY State Department of Tax and Finance DTF-802, available at any motor vehicle office and the DMV internet site.

18860.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18860.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18860.text: If you have a complaint about your vehicle ,

18861.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18861.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18861.text: bring it to the attention of the dealership management right away.

18862.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18862.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18862.text: Keep a record of all contacts with the dealer about the vehicle and any repairs or adjustments made.

18863.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18863.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18863.text: Keep copies of all work orders and invoices as proof of your attempts to resolve the problem.

18864.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18864.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18864.text: If you cannot resolve the problem with the dealer ,

18865.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18865.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18865.text: write to: Bureau of Consumer and Facility Services, PO Box 2700-ESP, Albany, NY 12220 - 0700, or phone 518 474 - 8943 between 8:30 a.m. and 4:15 p.m. weekdays.

18866.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18866.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18866.text: If your complaint concerns a repair ,

18867.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18867.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18867.text: you must file it with the Department of Motor Vehicles within 90 days or 3,000 miles of the repair, whichever comes first.

18868.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18868.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18868.text: If your complaint does not fall within its jurisdiction ,

18869.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18869.heading: Department of Motor Vehicles Consumer Assistance
18869.text: DMV will refer you to the proper agency.

18870.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18870.heading: Lemon Laws
18870.text: New York State's new and used car lemon laws provide legal remedies for consumers who buy or lease cars.

18871.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18871.heading: Lemon Laws
18871.text: If a car does not live up to the written warranty and cannot be repaired -

18872.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18872.heading: Lemon Laws
18872.text: or if it has not been repaired correctly after a reasonable number of attempts -

18873.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18873.heading: Lemon Laws
18873.text: the consumer could receive a refund or replacement car.

18874.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18874.heading: Lemon Laws
18874.text: For information and assistance concerning the Lemon Laws ,

18875.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18875.heading: Lemon Laws
18875.text: Office of the Attorney General [5] Albany ,

18876.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18876.heading: Lemon Laws
18876.text: 1 - 800 - 771 - 7755 or 1 - 518 - 474 - 5481 or any regional office of the Attorney General.

18877.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18877.heading: Lemon Laws
18877.text: You may also contact: Department of State, Division of Consumer Protection Consumer Assistance Unit 99 Washington Avenue, Albany, NY 12231 - 0001 Telephone : 1 - 800 - 697 - 1220 or 1 - 518 - 474 - 8583.

18879.title: Let the Buyer be Aware#3
18879.heading: Lemon Laws
18879.text: NEW YORK STATE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLESMark J. F. Schroeder ,

18882.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18882.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp2
18882.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18882.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities ensures safe and equal access to goods and services, access which most of us take for granted.

18883.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18883.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp3
18883.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18883.text: This publication explains the rules that businesses and all drivers should observe about reserved parking spaces.

18884.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18884.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp4
18884.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18884.text: It also presents information on how to obtain license plates and parking permits that allow individuals with severe disabilities to use specially - marked parking spots.

18885.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18885.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp5
18885.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18885.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities is a legal requirement, not just a courtesy.

18886.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18886.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp6
18886.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18886.text: You can help support the law by parking in reserved spaces only if you have a permit or plates for people with disabilities, and only when the person who received the permit or plates is actually in the vehicle.

18887.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18887.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp7
18887.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18887.text: Please avoid parking in the access aisle or striped area next to a reserved parking space -

18888.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18888.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp9
18888.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18888.text: This special area is needed for access by people who use wheelchairs and specially - equipped vehicles.

18889.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18889.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp10
18889.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18889.text: It is important to respect each other.

18890.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18890.text: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:

18891.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp14
18891.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18891.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18891.text: A qualifying disability is one or more of the following impairments, disabilities or conditions that are both permanent in nature and affect mobility :

18892.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18892.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp17
18892.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18892.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18892.text: Limited use, or no use, of one or both legs ;

18893.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp18
18893.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18893.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18893.text: Inability to walk 200 feet without stopping ;

18894.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0

18894.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18894.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18894.text: A neuro - muscular dysfunction that severely limits mobility ;

18895.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18895.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp20
18895.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18895.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18895.text: A Class III or IV cardiac condition American Heart Association standards ;

18896.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18896.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp21
18896.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18896.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18896.text: Severe limitation in the ability to walk due to an arthritic, neurological or orthopedic condition ;

18897.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18897.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp22
18897.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18897.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18897.text: Restriction because of lung disease to such an extent that forced respiratory expiratory volume for one second, when measured by spirometry, is less than one liter ,

18898.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp23
18898.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18898.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18898.text: or the arterial oxygen tension is less than sixty mm / hg of room air at rest ;

18899.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18899.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp24
18899.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18899.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18899.text: Any other physical or mental impairment not previously listed which constitutes an equal degree of disability ,

18900.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18900.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp25
18900.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18900.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18900.text: and imposes unusual hardship in the use of public transportation and prevents the person from getting around without great difficulty.

18901.text: may be issued when a person has a temporarily disabling condition that makes the person unable to walk without a cane, crutches, a walker or other assisting device.

18902.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp31
18902.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18902.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18902.text: To qualify for the license plates or the parking permit ,

18903.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp32
18903.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3

18903.text: you must present proof of the disability from a medical doctor MD, doctor of osteopathy DO, doctor of podiatric medicine DPM, licensed in NYS only or optometrist OD, for blindness.

18904.doc_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0
18904.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp33
18904.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18904.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18904.text: Only these medical professionals are considered " doctors " as the term is used in this publication.

18905.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp34

18905.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18905.text: A doctor licensed in New York or another state may certify for conditions #1 through #8 previously listed.

18906.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp35

18906.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18906.text: Only doctors licensed in New York State may certify for condition #9.

18907.section_id: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3_0__sp36

18907.heading: Qualifying Disabilities For Plates or a Parking Permit for People With Severe Disabilities:
18907.text: A podiatrist must be licensed in NYS, and may certify applicants only for severe disabilities of the foot.

18908.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3
18908.heading: Proof of Disability
18908.text: You may provide one of these proofs of disability :

18909.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3

18917.text: If you have an obvious, visible, permanent disability, such as the complete or partial loss of a leg or foot, the requirement for a medical statement may be waived by a DMV supervisor if you are applying for the license plates, or by the local issuing agent if you are applying for a permit.

18918.title: Parking for People with Disabilities - The Law#3

18918.text: If you have moved to NYS and want to apply for New York State license plates or a parking permit for people with disabilities ,

18998.text: Plates and permits do not allow you to disobey state or local parking regulations.

18999.text: They also do not exempt you from parking fees unless a locality has adopted an ordinance to that effect.

19000.heading: Proper Use of Valid Permits or License Plates
19000.text: The fine for illegally parking in a space reserved for people with disabilities is $50 to $150, plus a mandatory $30 surcharge.

19002.text: It is a serious misuse of license plates and permits for people with disabilities when someone other that the person with a disability uses the plates or permit to park in a space reserved for people with disabilities.

19003.text: These license plates or parking permits are valid only when the person with a disability who received the plates or permit is driving the vehicle or is a passenger in it.

19135.title: Lifetime driving records#3
19135.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
19135.text: A " lifetime " driving record contains all the license information DMV currently has available about a driver.

19136.title: Lifetime driving records#3
19136.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
19136.text: The lifetime driving record will display all information still in DMV s possession regardless of the data retention requirements found in Vehicle and Traffic Law.

19137.title: Lifetime driving records#3
19137.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
19137.text: The record may not include information that dates back to when a driver was initially granted driving privileges.

19138.title: Lifetime driving records#3
19138.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
19138.text: A standard driver license abstract only contains information that DMV is still required to keep.

19139.title: Lifetime driving records#3
19139.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
19139.text: most suspensions and revocations are only shown on the standard driving record abstract for 4 years from the date the suspension or revocation ended.

19140.heading: What information appears on a lifetime driving record?
